jobs.description:
As a Team Leader – Production, you play a key role in our manufacturing operations. You are responsible for coordinating the daily production activities while leading and supporting your team. By combining a people-oriented leadership style with a focus on quality, safety, and continuous improvement, you help achieve production targets and maintain the highest quality standards.

Your Responsibilities:

• Lead, coach, and motivate operators on the production line.
• Foster a positive, respectful, and collaborative team environment.
• Monitor and continuously improve quality, safety, and workplace organisation.
• Oversee the daily production schedule and ensure the production line operates efficiently.
• Manage stock levels and ensure the correct use of materials.
• Work with production software and ERP systems, including Iris and Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central.
• Perform basic administrative tasks and prepare production reports.
• Communicate effectively in either Dutch or English with colleagues and stakeholders.

Are You the Team Leader We're Looking For?

• You have strong leadership and coaching skills and know how to inspire a team.
• You communicate confidently, clearly, and with a positive attitude.
• You are comfortable working with computer systems and quickly adapt to new software.
• You work accurately and have a strong focus on quality, safety, and efficiency.
• You are fluent in Dutch and/or English.
• Experience in a manufacturing or production environment is an advantage.

ViaMotive is not a traditional company. As a multi-brand dealer for brands such as Higer, Temsa and EVM, we provide smart solutions for professional passenger transport.
 

With the growing number of electric buses, our workshop is changing too. That's why we're looking for a skilled 
Diagnostic Bus Technician to join our team.
 

At ViaMotive, you will diagnose technical problems on modern buses and work together with your colleagues to get our vehicles safely back on the road. Every day is different and offers new technical challenges.
 

Your job
 

As a Diagnostic Technician, you will find, analyse and solve technical problems on buses.
 

Your tasks include:
 
 

• Diagnosing technical faults using diagnostic equipment. 

• Reading fault codes and electrical diagrams. 

• Solving mechanical, electrical and electronic problems. 

• Carrying out maintenance and repairs. 

• Testing vehicles after repairs. 

• Helping colleagues with more complex technical issues. 

• Learning about new technologies, including electric buses. 

Who are you?
 
 

• You have a degree in Automotive Technology, Electromechanics, or similar experience. 

• You have experience as a diagnostic technician, bus technician or truck technician. 

• You have a good knowledge of mechanics, electricity and electronics. 

• You have experience using diagnostic tools. 

• You have a category B driving licence (category D is a plus). 

• You can communicate in English or Dutch. 

• You work accurately, care about quality and enjoy working in a team.  

Experience with electric vehicles or an HEV2 certificate is an advantage, but not required. A strong technical mindset and willingness to learn are just as important.
 

Practical
 
 

• Day shift from Monday to Friday. 

• Roadside assistance is mainly during working hours. If you are willing to help outside working hours when needed, this is a plus.

jobs.occupation: R&D Group Manager – Compute Platforms & Silicon Prototypes
jobs.description:
Lead the team that turns breakthrough compute architectures into working silicon for the future of AI, high-performance computing and automotive systems.
 

About the role
 

What if you could lead the team that transforms breakthrough chip architectures into real silicon?

At imec, you will manage a multidisciplinary group developing advanced compute platforms and silicon prototypes that explore the future of artificial intelligence, high-performance computing (HPC) and automotive systems. Your work will help define how next-generation chips are designed, integrated and manufactured beyond today's conventional system-on-chip approaches.

You will combine scientific leadership, people management and technology vision in one of the world's leading semiconductor research environments.

 

What you will do
 

As R&D Group Manager, you will lead a team of architects and engineers developing advanced compute systems from concept to silicon validation.

You will:
 
 

• Lead a team of chip architects, silicon designers and R&D engineers. 

• Translate novel computing concepts into manufacturable silicon demonstrators. 

• Drive the development of next-generation compute platforms based on RISC-V and chiplet-based architectures. 

• Guide projects across the complete development cycle, from architectural exploration to prototype fabrication. 

• Enable close collaboration between architecture, software, design technology and silicon implementation experts. 

• Build a high-performing team by coaching, mentoring and developing researchers and engineers. 

• Help shape imec's vision for future 3D-integrated computing systems.  

Who you are
 

You combine deep technical expertise with strong people leadership.

You bring:

Must-have
 
 

• 10+ years of experience in digital system architecture and semiconductor design. 

• Solid understanding of advanced chip and compute-system development. 

• Experience with RISC-V or similar processor architectures. 

• Previous experience leading engineers, researchers or technical experts. 

• Strong communication skills and fluency in English.  

Nice-to-have
 
 

• Experience with chiplet-based architectures and die-to-die interconnect technologies. 

• Knowledge of hardware modelling and hardware generation methodologies. 

• Experience with advanced verification methodologies and design automation flows.

jobs.occupation: Startup and Ecosystem Manager – EU Chips Design Platform
jobs.description:
Help Europe’s most ambitious semiconductor startups move from breakthrough ideas to market-ready chips.
Apply About the role 
 

Europe is investing heavily in semiconductor innovation, and the EU Chips Design Platform is at the center of that transformation.

As a Startup and Ecosystem Manager, you'll become a trusted partner for startups, SMEs, research organizations and fabless innovators across Europe. You'll guide them through the platform, connect them with the right expertise and resources, and help accelerate their path from concept to silicon.
 

What you will do
 

In this role, you'll combine ecosystem building, stakeholder management and startup support.

You will:
 
 

• Guide and onboard users of the EU Chips Design Platform throughout their innovation journey. 

• Act as the primary contact for startups, SMEs and research teams using the platform. 

• Manage imec's contribution to the Venture Development Program, including mentoring, incubation and acceleration activities. 

• Support participants in applying for Financial Support to Third Parties (FSTP) funding opportunities. 

• Promote the platform across the European semiconductor ecosystem. 

• Build strong relationships with startups, investors, competence centers and industry stakeholders throughout Europe. 

• Identify opportunities to improve the user experience and continuously strengthen the platform's services. 

• Help shape a thriving European chip design community.

   

Why this role is unique
 

This is more than an account management role. You'll help build the ecosystem that enables the next generation of European chip companies to succeed. It offers the unique combination of: 
 
 

• Direct impact on Europe's semiconductor future. 

• Daily interaction with ambitious deep-tech startups. 

• Exposure to a broad network of innovators, investors and technology leaders. 

• The opportunity to help build a flagship initiative under the European Chips Act. 

• The reputation, expertise and global reach of imec behind you.  

You'll have the chance to influence how tomorrow's chip companies are created, funded and scaled.

Who you are
 

We're looking for someone who combines technical understanding with a passion for helping innovators succeed, with:
 
 

• A PhD, Master's degree or equivalent experience in microelectronics, electrical engineering, physics or a related field. 

• Knowledge of ASIC design and semiconductor development. 

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills. 

• A customer-focused mindset and entrepreneurial attitude. 

• Willingness to travel frequently (10 % of your time) mostly in Europe. 

• Excellent English communication skills.  

It’s an asset if you also bring: 
 
 

• Experience working with startups or innovation ecosystems. 

• Familiarity with venture development, incubation or accelerator programs. 

• An existing network within the European semiconductor ecosystem. 

• Experience with multiple chip design flows or EDA tools.

Let's talk business
 
 

• Ready to take on the world? Because in this role you’ll implement MES systems at our customers in the plastics and textile industry worldwide. This includes both new installations as implementing upgrades. 

• You'll be prepping installations and fine-tuning applications to ensure a smooth installation at the customer. 

• You’ll install and configure the software on-site, taking into account the specific needs of the customer. You’ll be a guru to our customers: you’ll guide, train and support them when they start using our systems. 

• You will be part of a larger worldwide team but in this role your colleagues from the Installation and Service team and the Development team will be your work besties. 

• When you're not out in the field, you'll be the go-to guy or girl for our HQ, providing top-notch remote support to our customers. It's your change to dive into challenges, solve issues, and keep things running smoothly. 

Let's talk you
 
 

• You hold a Master's degree in ICT, NMCT, electronics or have an equivalent knowledge about MES gained through hands-on experience. We also offer technically skilled school leavers the opportunity to embark on an adventure with us. 

• Knowledge of Windows systems and relational databases (Oracle, SQL Server) is a plus, just like basic knowledge of MES or ERP systems. 

• You're open to the occasional trip abroad to connect with our customers and experience different cultures. 

• As an autonomous, customer-oriented, and stress-resistant person, you thrive on finding solutions and delivering top-notch service. Fluent communication and killer teamwork skills are a must. 

• You can express yourself practically in different languages. Fluency in English is a must, and you should be confident communicating in at least two additional languages to support our global customer base effectively.

Application Process

As a Van Driver & Logistics Operator, you are the link between our workshop and our customers. You will be responsible for carrying out daily logistics operations across Brussels and throughout Belgium, ensuring that every customer receives a scooter that meets our quality standards.

You will be one of the faces of MUTE on the road and will play a key role in delivering an exceptional customer experience.

Your Responsibilities

Deliveries & Collections

• Deliver electric scooters to customers.
• Collect scooters requiring maintenance or repairs.
• Carry out vehicle swaps when needed.
• Load and unload scooters safely and efficiently.
Logistics Operations

• Optimize routes to maximize operational efficiency.
• Keep the company van clean, organized and in good condition.
• Report any damage or operational issues concerning transported vehicles.
Customer Service

• Represent MUTE professionally during every customer interaction.
• Introduce customers to the basic operation of their scooter upon delivery.
• Answer basic customer questions.
• Ensure every delivery reflects the high service standards of MUTE.
Operational Support

When deliveries are completed, you will support the workshop and logistics team by:

• Moving scooters within the warehouse.
• Preparing vehicles for delivery.
• Cleaning and inspecting scooters.
• Charging and handling batteries safely.
• Assisting the operations team based on daily priorities. 
We are looking for someone who is reliable, proactive and enjoys working independently.

Requirements

• Comfortable driving a delivery van in urban environments.
• Reliable, punctual and well organized.
• Careful with equipment and company vehicles.

jobs.occupation: warehouse worker / forklift operator - night shift
jobs.description:
Looking for a permanent job on the fixed night shift within an international logistics environment? Then this job might be just the thing for you.

Your responsibilities:

• Loading and unloading containers and trucks with the forklift according to applicable safety procedures.
• Operating the forklift and electric pallet trucks for the efficient internal transport of goods.
• Managing and accurately moving goods within the cold warehouse.
• As a warehouse worker and forklift driver, you work closely with colleagues to ensure the logistics process runs smoothly at night.
You work in a fixed night shift. Start time can be at 16:00 or at 18:30. You choose one of the two for your entire employment.

VG 458/BUOSAP

You hold a forklift certificate, or are willing to take a practical driving test.

You are fluent in Dutch or English (both spoken and written).

You are a great team player.

You prioritize working safely and accurately.

You ensure an optimal flow of goods throughout the entire night shift.

Job description 

Depending on your location, you will start your journey from Genk, Antwerp, or Zeebrugge. You are free to choose your own departure time, provided that you leave before 5:00 a.m. Please note that you must inspect the vehicles for any damage before departure. Ensuring the load is properly secured is a key responsibility!

If you prefer to stay overnight during your routes, this can certainly be discussed.

With the loading list assigned to you, you will have a clear overview of your route and know exactly where to go.

Are you able to provide a highly secure parking location for the truck at your home? Great! If not, you will use your own vehicle to travel to the departure location each time and return the truck in excellent condition after completing your route.

You are able to communicate effectively in Dutch, French, and/or English.

 Requirements 

National routes, with occasional trips across the border to the Netherlands, Luxembourg, or France.

No experience is required; we are looking for passion and motivation for vehicle transport.

A CE driving licence, Code 95 qualification, and a valid medical fitness certificate are required.

Job description 

Your job in a nutshell
 In the evening, when others go to sleep, your workday begins. Between 22h and 00h, you depart with a refrigerated truck towards your first delivery.
 You drive throughout Belgium and deliver to various supermarkets. No stressful city driving, but clear routes and a well-organised schedule.

What will you do?
 • You load and unload using an electric or manual pallet jack
 • You deliver fruits and vegetables to supermarkets across Belgium
 • You check deliveries and documents
 • You drive independently and take responsibility for your own route
 • You ensure correct and safe deliveries

What does your day look like?
 • You start at night at the depot, pick up your truck and depart on your route
 • During your shift you typically make 2 to 6 stops per night and complete your deliveries efficiently. Your workday lasts on average 12 to 15 hours, but you work within a clear and structured system without chaos or unnecessary stress
 • After your round, you return to the depot (Geel) and your workday is finished—and the best part? You simply sleep at home in your own bed

What do we expect from you?
 • CE driving licence with certificates (Code 95 – medical fitness certificate)
 • Good knowledge of English is a must, Lithuanian is a plus
 • You are flexible and customer-oriented
 • You live in the Geel region
 • You perform physical work with a smile
 • Willingness to work weekends (Saturdays and Sundays)

What do you get in return?
 • A very good salary in relation to your effort and hours
 • Many working hours, no hotel nights—always sleeping at home
 • Working with clear structure and fixed routes
 • Permanent contract after a successful temporary employment period

Interested? Apply today and jump on board!

 Requirements 

• CE driving licence with certificates
 • Flexible mindset
 • Good knowledge of English, Russian or Lithuanian
 • Living in the Geel region

Transport of mainly sea containers in and around the port of Antwerp or Rotterdam during the night shift.

For our client in the Veurne region, we are looking for a DIAGNOSIC TECHNICIAN.

The garage not only sells and rents high-quality German vehicles, but also carries out maintenance and repairs to the highest standards.

As a diagnosic technician in the Veurne region, your responsibilities include:

  • Performing vehicle diagnostics;
  • Establishing diagnoses and setting up diagnostic equipment;
  • Carrying out repairs and replacing parts;
  • Working on passenger cars, vans and trucks (depending on experience and skills);
  • Performing maintenance work;
  • Resolving mechanical and electronic issues.
As a diagnosic Technician in the Veurne region, you recognize yourself in the following:

  • You already have a basic knowledge of automotive technology;
  • You are a motivated technician with a passion for technology;
  • You speak Dutch or English.

Job description 

You will be responsible for delivering meat to companies, distribution centers, or supermarkets with a refrigerated trailer.

Possibility of driving shuttles between the customer and distribution centers.

Loading at the processor and 2 to 3 stops per day. Unloading at the dock or using the loading bridge and electric pallet truck.

Working from Monday to Friday.

 

 Requirements 

    
• CE driver's license with a valid C95.
    
• You have initial experience in refrigerated transport.
    
• You are Dutch or speak English well.
    
• Shifts from 10 to 13 hours per day.
    
• Good, open communication with planning/management.
